The rest of stdin is\n;; deliberately left alone: interpreted programs use the ordinary read.\n\n(define (second x) (car (cdr x)))\n(define (third x) (car (cdr (cdr x))))\n\n;; Environments are (bindings . parent), and bindings are association lists.\n;; A binding is a mutable pair, which makes set! work through closures.\n(define (make-env bindings parent) (cons bindings parent))\n(define (env-bindings e) (car e))\n(define (env-parent e) (cdr e))\n\n(define (find-binding name bindings)\n  (if (null? bindings)\n      #f\n      (if (eq? name (car (car bindings)))\n          (car bindings)\n          (find-binding name (cdr bindings)))))\n\n(define (lookup name e)\n  (let ((b (find-binding name (env-bindings e))))\n    (if b\n        (cdr b)\n        (if (null? (env-parent e))\n            #f\n            (lookup name (env-parent e))))))\n\n(define (define-variable name value e)\n  (set-car! e (cons (cons name value) (env-bindings e)))\n  #f)\n\n(define (set-variable name value e)\n  (let ((b (find-binding name (env-bindings e))))\n    (if b\n        (set-cdr! b value)\n        (if (null? (env-parent e))\n            #f\n            (set-variable name value (env-parent e)))))\n  #f)\n\n;; Procedures made by this evaluator are tagged lists.  Primitive procedures\n;; are tagged too, since the source language has no primitive apply operation.\n(define (closure params body env)\n  (cons 'closure (cons params (cons body env))))\n(define (primitive name) (cons 'primitive name))\n\n(define (sequence body env)\n  (if (null? body)\n      #f\n      (begin\n        (if (null? (cdr body))\n            (eval (car body) env)\n            (begin (eval (car body) env)\n                   (sequence (cdr body) env))))))\n\n(define (argument-values expressions env)\n  (if (null? expressions)\n      '()\n      (cons (eval (car expressions) env)\n            (argument-values (cdr expressions) env))))\n\n(define (sum-list xs)\n  (if (null? xs) 0 (+ (car xs) (sum-list (cdr xs)))))\n(define (product-list xs)\n  (if (null? xs) 1 (* (car xs) (product-list (cdr xs)))))\n\n;; Apply a tagged primitive or a closure.  The dispatch below mirrors the\n;; primitive names installed by make_global_env in interp.py.\n(define (apply-primitive name args)\n  (cond\n   ((eq? name '+) (sum-list args))\n   ((eq? name '*) (product-list args))\n   ((eq? name '-) (if (null?
